key_insight: A no-code, in-house LLM workflow can automate row-by-row analysis of tabular clinical data while keeping protected health information inside a HIPAA-compliant environment.
clinical_relevance: This could speed up chart review and registry abstraction for oncology and other clinical research tasks, freeing staff for higher-value analysis.
method: Imports Excel or text tabular data into a user-friendly interface
Guides users through prompt engineering for extraction or summarization
Submits each row to a secure in-house ChatGPT 4o-mini and tabulates outputs
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful use across multiple real-world data sources, including pathology reports, cancer registries, cardiology CT reports, imaging narratives, and clinical notes.
watch_item: Performance appears to be based on deployment experience rather than formal benchmarking, so accuracy, consistency, and workflow validation should be confirmed before broad use.
paper_title: A user-friendly, no-code, application for HIPAA-compliant automated analysis of tabular data at scale
